api_database_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection URI for the API database.

conductor_host.description: IP address or hostname the conductor service binds to.

conductor_local_mode.description: Enable local mode (handles operations directly instead of via RPC). Should only be used for single-node dev setups.

conductor_port.description: Port on which the conductor service listens for incoming HTTP requests.

conductor_workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

database_connection.description: SQLAlchemy connection URI for the main (cell) database.

db_max_pool_size.description: Maximum number of pooled database connections.

keystone_password.description: Password for the nova service user in Keystone. Leave blank to inject via secrets (e.g., barbican or file).

keystone_username.description: Service user username for authentication with Keystone.

log_dir.description: Directory where nova-conductor writes log files.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

rabbitmq_host.description: Hostname or IP of RabbitMQ server.

rabbitmq_password.description: Password for the RabbitMQ user. Use secret injection in production.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate bundle for client verification (optional).

ssl_certfile.description: Path to TLS certificate file (requires ssl_enabled=true).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for conductor API endpoints.

ssl_keyfile.description: Path to TLS private key file (requires ssl_enabled=true).
